questions.explanation: RAS DASHEN in the Simien Mountains is Ethiopia's highest peak at 4,550 meters. It's located in the North Central Massifs (Amhara region). Mount Entoto is near Addis Ababa but lower. Mount Batu is in Bale (eastern highlands).
The DALLLOL DEPRESSION in the Afar region is Ethiopia's lowest point at approximately 125 meters BELOW sea level. It's also one of the hottest places on Earth. Lake Tana is at ~1,800m elevation.

questions.text: How many MAJOR physiographic divisions does Ethiopia have?
questions.explanation: Ethiopia has FOUR major physiographic divisions: (1) Western Highlands, (2) Western Lowlands, (3) Eastern Highlands, (4) Eastern Lowlands. Each has distinct elevation and features.

questions.text: The LARGEST physiographic region in Ethiopia is:
questions.explanation: The WESTERN HIGHLANDS are Ethiopia's LARGEST and most important physiographic region. They include the Tigray Plateau, North Central Massifs, Shewa Plateau, and South Western Highlands. This region contains most of Ethiopia's population and agricultural land.

questions.text: Examine the profile. Which section represents the RIFT VALLEY?

questions.explanation: The YELLOW depression (B) between the two plateaus represents the RIFT VALLEY. A (green) is Western Plateau, C (red) is Eastern Plateau, D (blue) is Lowlands. The Rift Valley is a tectonic depression between the two plateaus.

questions.text: The TIGRAY PLATEAU is composed primarily of:
questions.explanation: The TIGRAY PLATEAU is composed of SANDSTONE and LIMESTONE — sedimentary rocks from the Mesozoic era. These rocks form distinctive stepped landscapes and contain historic sites like Aksum's obelisks. Volcanic basalt dominates the North Central Massifs.

questions.text: Ras Dashen is located in which sub-region?
questions.explanation: RAS DASHEN (Ethiopia's highest peak at 4,550m) is in the NORTH CENTRAL MASSIFS in the Simien Mountains. This sub-region has the HIGHEST elevations in Ethiopia and is composed of volcanic basalt.

questions.text: Addis Ababa is located in which sub-region?
questions.explanation: ADDIS ABABA (Ethiopia's capital) is located on the SHEWA PLATEAU (Central Highland) at an elevation of about 2,400 meters. The Shewa Plateau is drained by the Awash River and contains volcanic features like Mount Zuqualla.

questions.text: The SOUTH WESTERN HIGHLANDS are known for:
options: B) Having the HIGHEST rainfall and coffee production
questions.correct_answer: B) Having the HIGHEST rainfall and coffee production
questions.explanation: The SOUTH WESTERN HIGHLANDS (Jimma, Illubabor) receive the HIGHEST rainfall in Ethiopia and are the main COFFEE growing regions. They are covered in dense forests and drained by the Omo and Ghibe rivers.

questions.text: The AB AY-DINDER LOWLAND is drained by which river?
questions.explanation: The ABAY-DINDER LOWLAND is drained by the ABAY (BLUE NILE) RIVER along Ethiopia's western border. The Tekeze Lowland is drained by Tekeze River, Baro Lowland by Baro River, and Ghibe Lowland by Ghibe/Omo River.
